author: Aoife M.
text: Bought a low-mileage Japanese import from CF Motor Sales. The car was exactly as described and they sorted the VRT and NCT before I collected it. Genuinely painless.

author: Declan R.
text: Sourced a specific spec of Toyota for me from the UK. Kept me updated the whole way through the import. Would not go anywhere else now.

author: Sarah K.
text: Fantastic service, no pressure at all. The Japanese cars they bring in are a different league on condition compared to what I was seeing on the usual sites.

author: Michael B.
text: Traded in my old car and picked up a hybrid import. Fair price on the trade-in and the whole thing was handled over WhatsApp until collection day.

author: Niamh C.
text: Really happy with the car. Only reason for 4 stars is I had to wait a couple of weeks for the import, but that was clearly explained up front.

author: Liam O.
text: Top class. Full history, low km, and they walked me through everything about the import and VRT. Highly recommend for anyone nervous about buying an import.
